title: DLAMA: A Framework for Curating Culturally Diverse Facts for Probing the Knowledge of Pretrained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing factual recall performance (Precision at 1) of Pretrained Language Models on facts sourced from Western versus non-Western (Arab, Asian, South American) cultures using the proposed DLAMA benchmark.

Analyzing the most frequent model predictions to identify if models systematically overgenerate answers related to the prompt's language (e.g., predicting 'Italy' simply because the prompt is in Italian) regardless of the factual subject.
